text: Welcome Tom Okafor, joining as a frontend engineer working on the dashboard. Tom, the two people to know first are Priya for anything infra and Devika for what customers are actually complaining about.
Thanks! Where do decisions get written down? I've found three docs that all look canonical.
Honest answer: decisions live in GitHub issues, discussion lives in Slack, and the docs site is out of date. If you can't find why something is the way it is, ask in #eng.
Convention reminder since it keeps coming up: if a decision changes, we update the original issue and link forward. We do not open a new issue and let the old one rot.
